description: This file defines the interface for the DM_AmxRPCInterface module, including function declarations for initialization and cleanup, as well as include directives for related headers. It serves as a contract for other parts of the project to interact with the AMX RPC interface in the context of the TR-069 device management system.

methods.name: DM_AmxRPCInterface_init
methods.description: Initializes the AMX RPC interface with the provided bus context.

methods.name: DM_AmxRPCInterface_clean
methods.description: Performs cleanup tasks for the AMX RPC interface, releasing resources.
